artifacts.name: agents-guide
artifacts.description: Authoritative project guide for agents and contributors. Project overview, full src/ layout (every module's purpose), env vars, server lifecycle (port 8000=systemd, 8001=dev), commit conventions, DB trigger rules, and pointers to STYLE.md.

artifacts.name: readme
artifacts.description: Top-level project README. Brief project description and setup instructions for the watcher web service, a general-purpose monitor that fingerprints the content at registered URLs on a schedule and reports each change.

artifacts.name: style-guide
artifacts.description: UI/CSS/accessibility style guide. Brand colors (Cannabis Observer / co-purple-600), Tailwind v4 component classes (.btn, .badge, .stat-card, .data-table, .form-input, .link, .segment-group, .chip-group, .detail-grid, .toggle), badge variants, dark mode rules, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility patterns, HTMX OOB flash conventions, vendor CSS @layer pattern.

artifacts.name: commands-reference
artifacts.description: Reference for common development commands: uv sync, pytest invocations, ruff, alembic migrations, FastAPI dev server, env loading.

artifacts.name: deployment-doc
artifacts.description: Production deployment guide. Systemd unit (watcher.service), port allocation (8000 live, 8001 dev), exe.dev proxy, restart procedure, install runbook, the disk-cleanup timer, and Archiver sync. The cannobserv wheelhouse and the notifier SDK's git-tag source moved to docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. Env files and variables moved to docs/ENVIRONMENT.md (#278). Host memory posture split out to docs/HOST-MEMORY.md (#309).

artifacts.name: dependencies-doc
artifacts.description: Dependency sources outside PyPI. The cannobserv wheelhouse (#220): co-core and co-core-aio resolve from ./.wheelhouse, mirrored from the private GCS index by scripts/sync_wheelhouse.py with the co-pypi-reader identity (ADC on the VM, WIF in CI), their exact pins in lockstep with CannObserv/processor and the wheel-to-wheel diff history of each bump. The notifier-client SDK (#284): a pinned HTTPS git-tag source in [tool.uv.sources], how to upgrade it, and the guards in tests/test_dependency_sources.py.

artifacts.name: host-memory-doc
artifacts.description: Host memory posture for co-watcher (#307, #309): no swap, agent sessions at oom_score_adj 0 since exe-init 14fd603 (#337; -1000 before, unkillable). The watcher.service MemoryLow reservation and why it is not a cap; the slice drop-ins in deploy/dropins/ (system.slice, system-postgresql.slice, postgresql@ template, tailscaled) and the rule that a unit keeps no more memory.low than every slice above it grants; the dependency-chain table; vm.min_free_kbytes, why earlyoom stays declined now that sessions are killable (#323, #337), and the pinned SocratiCode install.

artifacts.name: environment-doc
artifacts.description: Every env file and variable that configures a Watcher process, and the load order systemd and scripts/load-env.sh apply. Carries the three unit-only opt-in flags (WATCHER_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB #233, WATCHER_BUS_ENABLED #262, WATCHER_NOTIFIER_ENABLED #277), the unit-only /etc/watcher/notifier.env credential file and why it is separate (#278), the WATCHER_DEV_* scratch overrides scripts/dev_server.sh reads, and the retired/renamed variable history.

artifacts.name: skills-doc
artifacts.description: Agent skills index. Catalogues the skills available under skills/ (agentskills.io) and .claude/skills/ (Claude Code) directories, the vendored submodule repos they symlink into, and the SessionStart hook inventory registered in .claude/settings.json (socraticode-reminder prefetch, socraticode-health once-per-day index check, skills-submodule-update refresh) with the vendored install-hook.sh/install-refresh.sh commands that install and audit them. The SocratiCode tool table and index scope live in docs/SOCRATICODE.md, the shared-index client contract in docs/CO-INDEX.md (#300).

artifacts.name: socraticode-doc
artifacts.description: SocratiCode exploration reference. Above its END marker, generated by init-socraticode: the goal-to-tool table (schema questions scoped to artifactName alembic-migrations), per-tool notes, graph health, and index scope (.socraticodeignore governs the code index, this manifest the context store). Below it, repo-specific: why .socraticodeignore excludes the vendored skill trees (#240) and docs/plans/ (#300); the sibling link stubs that make includeLinked cross-repo search work — all four, ../archiver included since #311 — and the clone-drift hazard a stub avoids. The shared index on co-index (#300) — the client contract, its green-failing traps and the capped invocation — moved to docs/CO-INDEX.md.

artifacts.name: co-index-doc
artifacts.description: The shared SocratiCode index on co-index (#300): why watcher hosts no local Qdrant (#307), the two committed client files (.socraticode.json, the env block in .claude/settings.json) and the per-host QDRANT_API_KEY in settings.local.json, the traps that report green (QDRANT_HOST's port 16333, the short MagicDNS name, QDRANT_COLLECTION_PREFIX and branch-aware namespace splitting, the session's npx server rather than the pin), verification commands, and the capped out-of-band index invocation with its measured cost.

artifacts.name: design-and-plans
artifacts.description: Archive of design and implementation plan documents (2026-03-20 onward). Excluded from the code index by .socraticodeignore (#300), so this artifact is where plans are searched: pass artifactName design-and-plans. Captures the 'why' behind every feature: phase plans (foundation, content pipeline, fetching/scheduling, temporal profiles, changes API, notifications, dashboard), system designs (rate limiter, screenshot pipeline, notification template library, content options, watch creation service, API key management, diff viewer), and execution plans. Some are superseded but still encode rationale and trade-offs.

artifacts.name: alembic-migrations
artifacts.description: Database schema history as Alembic migrations; no separate schema.sql exists, so this is the canonical source of truth for schema. Starts from a genesis baseline squashing the pre-#234 chain (app_users, audit_log, domains, api_keys, watched_items, change_revisions, notification_templates, temporal_profiles, pending_archiver_sync), then: fetch_commands (#241) with their blob expiry (#253), info_source_id (#252) and conditional-GET validator and forced-full-fetch columns (#269); fetch_policy_tombstones (#245); required Archiver links (#251); the archiver outbox's dead-letter state and observation provenance (#253) and its due-predicate index (#291); registry reconcile state (#254); last_observed_at (#264); and drops of retired transport columns (#261), inert domain limiter columns (#272) and post-squash cruft. No database triggers remain — the last orphaned trigger function was dropped.

artifacts.name: systemd-unit
artifacts.description: Production systemd service unit for the watcher API. Defines how the live service on port 8000 is launched, restarted, and which env files it loads.
